name: Nyírbéltek (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyírbéltek: a crowned blue shield with a cross, a patriarchal cross and a hammer, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed NYÍRBÉLTEK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
